title: Excellent
text:
The visit was very successful. 
Eva very competent when it comes to explaining making us discover details that in the day visit we could not appreciate. 
Thank you very much for your attention and we will recommend you.
author: Magalenha2021

title: Wonderful experience
text: Taking advantage of the fact that family came to visit us, we booked an overnight visit to the Alhambra with Balea and it has been an unforgettable experience. Our guide was Eva, told us amazing stories and legends, showed us corners that surprised us and showed us details that we had never noticed. We were also able to go with our dogs, so the memory will be indelible, we enjoyed very much. You rating that Eva loves her work and conveys that passion, we feel very comfortable with her. We will repeat without a doubt, we very much want to continue making visits with her
author: Vanesa_CLV

title: Amazing and special experience
text: Unforgettable experience. Mystical visit to the Alhambra.  Our guide was Eva, and from minute zero we connected with her. She enjoys her work, she's a lover of the place, and that's conveyed. We will definitely be back, and we will have Eva's company again. Thank you.
author: 108ver_nicap

title: Better impossible

title: Alhambra at night
text: Great visit.    From minute 0, Eva did very close and conveyed a lot of confidence and great passion for her work.   Nice night full of details that without it would have gone unnoticed.  We really liked both the Alhambra and its company full of history.   Nice to meet you. Congratulations.
author: Moncalvos

title: Night visit 17/09
text:
Eva Rodríguez was our guide, a person who knows perfectly all corners of the Alhambra and who was able to interest us by its history and curiosities. 

It was very lucky to receive all that information, in addition to his sympathy and good vibes that he conveyed to us. 

The night visit also allows you to know the Alhambra from another point of view and appreciate details that by day (even if you have done so) you do not appreciate.

Highly recommended!
author: percandela
